description: "Per UTC day and tier, offersQuoted counts DeliveryOfferQuoted and promisesMade counts PromiseMade of that day (each by its own CloudEvents time); conversion = promisesMade / offersQuoted, null when no offer was quoted that day and tier. Days with neither are omitted. promiseCoverage (ADR 0030) adds, per UTC day, the offers quoted per region (the first two characters of the destination postal prefix; the ten regions with most requests, the rest folded into other) with the cumulative counts and shares of those promised within 1, 2, 3 and 5 days; it is a sibling of days, not a field of each tier row. Served by cmd/dp-reports (ADR 0018)."

Per UTC day and tier, offersQuoted counts DeliveryOfferQuoted and promisesMade counts PromiseMade of that day (each by its own CloudEvents time); conversion = promisesMade / offersQuoted, null when no offer was quoted that day and tier. Same-day counts, not an offer-to-promise cohort. Days with neither are omitted. promiseCoverage (ADR 0030) adds, per UTC day, the offers quoted per region (the first two characters of the destination postal prefix; the ten regions with most requests, the rest folded into other) with the cumulative counts and shares of those promised within 1, 2, 3 and 5 days; it is a sibling of days, not a field of each tier row. Served by cmd/dp-reports (ADR 0018).
